name: hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus
description: Applies a batch of photo-status changes in one round-trip: @updates is a JSON array of {photoId, action}. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 37, standard token). Gate, once per call: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'batchPhotos' for @kennelId (Hash Flash / GM / VGM / RA / WebMeister by the data-driven matrix) → else 1334 (errorType 13). Rows whose photoId is not a UUID or whose action is outside 1-6 are dropped at parse time; zero valid rows returns success with both counts 0. Items whose photo is not in @kennelId are counted as failures (LEFT JOIN before the writes) and the rest are committed regardless. Actions, set-based: 1 soft-delete (DeletedAt); 2-6 the audience ladder — ONE Status per photo: 0 Private, 2 Members, 3 Public, 4 Featured, 5 Cover — which also clears DeletedAt; 6 additionally demotes any other Cover of the same event to 3 and writes COALESCE(EditedBlobUrl, BlobUrl) to HC.Event.EventCoverPhotoUrl. Action 7 (unfeature) is retired: Featured is a ladder rung, un-feature = pick a lower rung (matches the portal SP).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns all photos in the batch. Used for role check and to scope all UPDATE statements.

parameters.name: updates
parameters.description: JSON array [{"photoId":"<uuid>","action":<1-6>}, …]. Unparseable photoIds and actions outside 1-6 are silently skipped before counting. 1 soft-delete; 2 private (Status 0); 3 members (2); 4 public (3); 5 featured (4); 6 event cover (5). No SQL default.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success: { success = 1, successCount, failureCount } — also for an empty/invalid batch (0, 0) with no second rowset. On failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the error detail at index 1: ValidateAppAuth 1137 (errorType 1) / 1337 (3) / 1237 (7); 1334 not authorised (13); 1933 unhandled (19). The two shapes share only the success column.

columns.name: success
columns.description: 1 on success or empty batch, 0 on auth/validation/DB failure.

columns.name: successCount
columns.description: Number of photos successfully actioned. NULL on error paths that include a second rowset.

columns.name: failureCount
columns.description: Number of submitted items where the photo was not found in the kennel. NULL on error paths.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. Present only on error paths (auth/validation/DB failure).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. Present only on error paths.

rowsets.description: Returned only on auth failure, role check failure, or unhandled DB error. Not present on success or empty-batch paths.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.KennelPhotos: DeletedAt + UpdatedAt for action 1; Status + DeletedAt = NULL + UpdatedAt for actions 2-6; previous Cover (Status 5) of the same event demoted to 3 for action 6 — all WHERE KennelId = @kennelId, inside one transaction.
UPDATE HC.Event.EventCoverPhotoUrl = COALESCE(KennelPhotos.EditedBlobUrl, BlobUrl) for action 6.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 1334 and in the CATCH (after ROLLBACK).
CREATE TABLE #Updates / DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Updates per call (the DROP at line 190 is skipped by the early RETURN at line 111; the temp table is freed at procedure end anyway).

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken, @kennelId, @updates (lines 3-6) have no SQL default. A client that omits any of them is refused by SQL BEFORE the procedure runs: no HC.ErrorLog row, an empty 500 in the app, and the SP's own graceful checks are unreachable (CLAUDE.md, Rack of Lamb 2026-09-29).

codeSmells.issue: Failure count based on LEFT JOIN, not actual UPDATE outcome
codeSmells.detail: Lines 115-123: failureCount is computed BEFORE the writes by counting items with no HC.KennelPhotos row in this kennel; successCount is submitted minus that. Neither reflects what the UPDATEs actually touched (e.g. a soft-deleted photo re-actioned counts as success).

codeSmells.issue: Rowset shape differs between success and error paths
codeSmells.detail: On success: rowset 0 has {success, successCount, failureCount}. On auth/role/DB error: rowset 0 has {success, errorCode, errorType} and rowset 1 is the standard error detail. These are structurally incompatible — the caller must branch on the presence of successCount to determine which shape was returned.

codeSmells.issue: errorCode 1933 is shared with other SPs' CATCH blocks
codeSmells.detail: Line 183: 1933 is also the unhandled code in hcapp_addDownDown and hcapp_cancelDownDown; errorProc is what distinguishes them.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
